name: sales-plan
description: Reviewed Actual-to-Plan sales scenarios for Vera.

interface.shortDescription: Create a reviewed sales Plan from Actuals and assumptions.
interface.longDescription: Vera Plan turns a reviewed monthly sales dataset into an Actual-to-Plan scenario using only confirmed commercial and foreign-exchange assumptions. Exact scopes, periods, priorities, source hashes, collisions, calculations, reconciliation, and replay evidence stay visible. The workflow prepares a Plan for professional review; it does not analyze historical performance, forecast by model inference, or approve management assumptions.
defaultPrompt: Create a sales Plan from these reviewed Actuals and assumptions.
Show the interpreted scope, driver, period, FX direction, and priority before calculating.
Deliver the Plan scenario, assumption ledger, summary, reconciliation, and execution receipt.
